pvcName.title: pvcName

schedule.title: schedule

storageClass.description: The `storageClassName` to attach the DB backup job for storage of regular DB backups. Leave the value empty to use your default Kubernetes storageClass

timeZone.title: timeZone

backupCron.title: backupCron

initialize.description: Initialize the DB. This is required for an initial deployment of Kasm to configure the DB for Kasm usage
initialize.title: initialize

initJobTTLSecondsAfterFinished.description: The number of seconds to retain the DB backup job pod after it has finished. The default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).
initJobTTLSecondsAfterFinished.title: initJobTTLSecondsAfterFinished

dbConnectionTimeout.description: The time in seconds to wait for the DB to respond to initContainer connection attempts.
dbConnectionTimeout.title: dbConnectionTimeout

enable.description: Enable the DB upgrade job to run.  NOTE: You cannot set both `dbManagement.initialize` and `dbManagement.upgrade.enabled` to true. You can either initialize the DB for a new installation, or you can upgrade an existing DB to a new Kasm version, but you cannot do both.
enable.title: enable

oldDbHostname.description: Hostname of the database from the previous Helm release. Only required if your old deployment used a non-default DB hostname (i.e. not kasm-db). Leave empty if using a standalone DB or to fall back to the default.

skipBackupAndRestore.description: Skip the chart-included pre-upgrade DB backup AND restore steps. ONLY supported with database.standalone=true; setting this with the chart-included DB causes the upgrade Job to fail-render. When true, the chart does not render the backup PVC/Job and the upgrade Job runs only the Kasm schema (alembic) migration against the already-restored standalone DB. Operator is responsible for performing pg_dump, Postgres major-version upgrade, and pg_restore manually before running helm upgrade. oldDbHostname and oldDbBackupFileName are ignored when this is true.
skipBackupAndRestore.title: skipBackupAndRestore

backupStorageClass.description: The storageClass to use to create PV for the backup PVC.
backupStorageClass.title: backupStorageClass

oldDbBackupFileName.description: The file name of the database backup to restore and upgrade.
oldDbBackupFileName.title: oldDbBackupFileName

oldDbSecretsName.description: The name of an existing Kubernetes secret to use as the source for credential lookup during upgrades. Leave empty to use the current release's '<release>-secrets' secret. Set to a different secret name only when upgrading from a deployment that stored credentials under a non-default name.
oldDbSecretsName.title: oldDbSecretsName

useImageTags.description: Chart-wide default image tag applied to every Kasm component image when a per-component `image.tag` is empty. Per-component `image.tag` (when set) overrides this. If both this and the per-component tag are empty, template rendering fails. Examples: `1.19.0-rolling`, `1.19.0`, `1.19.0-rolling-2026-06-02`.

deploymentSize.description: Define the estimated size of the Kasm deployment in expected session load.  small  = Up to 10-15 sessions  medium = Up to 25-30 sessions  large  = Up to 50+ sessions

directRdpService.description: Configure the directRdpService settings and service type to use for the Kasm RDP Gateway service. This is only applicable if you have enabled the Kasm RDP Gateway component in `components.rdpGateway.enabled`.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable a direct ClusterIP service for the Kasm RDP Gateway. This service will expose the RDP Gateway on port 3389 for direct RDP client connections. NOTE: Enabling this setting will not disable the RDP Gateway's main service which is meant for use with the RDP HTTPS Gateway or for connections proxied through the Kasm Proxy. This is meant to be an additional service to allow direct RDP client connections for users who wish to use the RDP Gateway in this way.
enabled.title: enabled

rdpAccessURL.description: The external URL to access the RDP Gateway direct service. This is used for generating correct URLs in the Kasm UI for users to connect their RDP clients to. This should be in the format of `rdp://hostname:port` or `rdp://ip:port` depending on how you have configured access to the direct RDP Gateway service.
rdpAccessURL.title: rdpAccessURL

type.description: The Kubernetes Service type to use for the direct RDP Gateway service. Allowed values are LoadBalancer or NodePort. The RDP Gateway speaks raw TCP, so any cloud load balancer backing this Service must be a Layer 4 / TCP type (e.g. NLB on AWS, not ALB).
type.title: type

loadBalancerPort.description: The external port exposed by the directRdpService Service when `directRdpService.type` is LoadBalancer. Defaults to 3389. Has no effect when `directRdpService.type` is NodePort.
loadBalancerPort.title: loadBalancerPort

annotations.description: Custom annotations to add to the direct RDP Gateway service. This is useful for adding things like LoadBalancer annotations if you have set `directRdpService.type` to LoadBalancer.
annotations.title: annotations

labels.description: Custom labels to add to the direct RDP Gateway service.
labels.title: labels

extraContainerVolumeMounts.description:
A list of objects for additional secrets, configmaps, or volume mounts. Useful for adding things
 like custom SSL certificates, config files, or data volumes to all Kasm containers
Example: 
  extraContainerVolumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      name: pkichain
      readOnly: true
      subPath: ca.crt
extraContainerVolumeMounts.title: extraContainerVolumeMounts

extraContainers.description:
Additional sidecar containers to run in every pod
Example
 - name: sidecar-example
   image: busybox
   command: [/bin/sh, -c, 'echo "Hello world"']
extraContainers.title: extraContainers

extraInitContainers.description:
Additional sidecar containers to run in every pod
Example
 - name: init-example
   image: busybox
   command: [/bin/sh, -c, 'echo "Hello world"']
extraInitContainers.title: extraInitContainers

extraInitVolumeMounts.description:
A list of objects for additional secrets, configmaps, or volume mounts. Useful for adding things
 like custom SSL certificates, config files, or data volumes to all Kasm Service Init containers
Example: 
  extraInitVolumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      name: pkichain
      readOnly: true
      subPath: ca.crt
extraInitVolumeMounts.title: extraInitVolumeMounts

isOpenshift.description:
isOpenshift -- Use this flag to remove Pod and Container security ID values and allow OpenShift to dynamically
set them in accordance with [OpenShift UIDs](https://www.redhat.com/en/blog/a-guide-to-openshift-and-uids) documentation.
isOpenshift.title: isOpenshift

kasmConfig.description: An object of arrays of Kasm settings used to generate a preseed initialization file

generatePreseed.title: generatePreseed
generatePreseed.description: Enable DB preseed template file generation. When true, a custom_properties.yaml is rendered from kasmConfig.config and merged with Kasm's default seed data during db-init. Opt-in; set to true explicitly for new installs that require preseed.

defaultApiUsers.title: defaultApiUsers
defaultApiUsers.description: Seed Kasm default API configs (Admin and Read/Only API keys). Only meaningful when generatePreseed is true. Opt-in.

defaultUsers.title: defaultUsers
defaultUsers.description: Seed Kasm default users and groups (admin@kasm.local, user@kasm.local, siteadmin@kasm.local, workspaceadmin@kasm.local, and standard groups). Only meaningful when generatePreseed is true. Opt-in.

adminUsername.title: adminUsername
adminUsername.description: Username for the privileged admin account in the default user seed. Defaults to admin@kasm.local. Has no effect when defaultUsers is false.

existingDefaultPropertiesSecret.title: existingDefaultPropertiesSecret
existingDefaultPropertiesSecret.description: Reference a customer-managed Secret containing a complete default_properties.yaml seed file. When name is set, its contents replace the image's baked-in default_properties.yaml as the base seed file, independently of generatePreseed.

name.title: name
name.description: Name of a pre-existing Secret containing the seed file. Leave empty to disable this feature.

key.title: key
key.description: Data key within the Secret that contains the seed file contents.

config.title: config
config.description: Preseed data sections. All user-supplied Kasm preseed data (users, groups, apiConfigs, settings, images, autoscale, server_pools, cloud VM configs, OIDC/SAML/LDAP, etc.) belong here. Control flags generatePreseed and defaultUsers remain at kasmConfig top level.

kasmZones.description: This is a list of objects defining different Kasm Zone configurations for your deployment. This configuration is typically used for multi-region, large, or custom deployments where the customer requires a high degree of configurability and has multiple resources in disparate areas.  NOTE: If you configure custom zones below, you MUST use a valid `ingress` configuration due to the increased deployment complexity of a multi-zone Kasm deployment. Refer to the Kasm [Deployment Zones](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/latest/guide/deployment_zones/index.html) documentation for more information on Kasm Zones.
kasmZones.title: kasmZones

allow_origin_domain.title: allow_origin_domain
allow_origin_domain.description: Connections to Kasm sessions are restricted to authorized Origins. This value is the authorized origin domain. The default is $request_host$.

enable_direct_rdp_login.title: enable_direct_rdp_login
enable_direct_rdp_login.description: Allow users to connect with this zone purely through RDP and their Kasm credentials. This connection method only works for RDP targets but allows clients to interact with Kasm without a web browser.

enable_rdp_https_gw.title: enable_rdp_https_gw
enable_rdp_https_gw.description: Use the HTTPS RDP Gateway protocol. When disabled, standard RDP over port 3389 is used.

enable_rdp_https_gw_dlp.title: enable_rdp_https_gw_dlp
enable_rdp_https_gw_dlp.description: Send HTTPS RDP connections through DLP (Data Loss Prevention). Enabling DLP has performance and scalability implications. Disabling DLP will disable many data loss prevention features enforced by Kasm, however, many of these features can be enforced by proper Group Policy in Windows. Disabling DLP will also break single sign on.

name.description: The name of the Kasm Zone to deploy management resources for. Required unless `zone_name` is set. If both `name` and `zone_name` are set, `name` wins.
name.title: name

primary.title: primary
primary.description: Set this value to true on the zone in the cluster with the Database. If you are deploying multiple zones in a single namespace and region, then just pick whichever Zone you want the chart to consider the primary.

proxyAddress.description: Deprecated. Use proxy_hostname instead to define the Proxy address of the Kasm Zones to deploy management resources for. Refer to [Deployment Zones](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/latest/guide/deployment_zones/index.html) for more info.
proxyAddress.title: proxyAddress

proxy_hostname.description: Define the Proxy address of the Kasm Zones to deploy management resources for. Refer to [Deployment Zones](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/latest/guide/deployment_zones/index.html) for more info.
proxy_hostname.title: proxy_hostname

proxy_path.title: proxy_path
proxy_path.description: The base path to append to the Kasm connection when Proxy Connections is enabled. The default is /desktop.

proxy_port.title: proxy_port
proxy_port.description: The port to use for the proxy server when Proxy Connections is enabled. The default is 443. Kasm Workspaces will attempt to automatically determine the correct port from window.location.port

prioritize_static_agents.title: prioritize_static_agents
prioritize_static_agents.description: Utilize fixed agents before using auto scaled Docker Agents. The default is enabled.

proxy_rdp_hostname.title: proxy_rdp_hostname
proxy_rdp_hostname.description: The hostname/ip of a load balancer or proxy in front of the HTTPS based RDP Gateway component. By default it is $request_host$.

proxy_rdp_port.title: proxy_rdp_port
proxy_rdp_port.description: The port number of a load balancer or proxy in front of the HTTPS based RDP Gateway component. By default it is 443.

region_name.title: region_name
region_name.description: The name of the region where the Zone is deployed. This is very useful if you wish to deploy multiple zones in a single region, you can use the same region_name value for all zones in the region and the Helm chart will deploy resources accordingly.

search_alternate_zones.title: search_alternate_zones
search_alternate_zones.description: When a user requests a Kasm session, the system will first search for available resources on Agents within the same Zone. When enabled, the server can also search alternate Zones to satisfy the request if it can not be satisfied within the same Zone. Agents in the same Zone are always preferred over alternate Zones.

upstream_auth_address.title: upstream_auth_address
upstream_auth_address.description: Connections to Kasm session are authenticated against a Kasm API server. This value is the address of the server. The default is $request_host$.

verify_rdp_client_ip.title: verify_rdp_client_ip
verify_rdp_client_ip.description: Allow users to connect with this zone purely through RDP and their Kasm credentials. This connection method only works for RDP targets but allows clients to interact with Kasm without a web browser.

zone_name.description: Preferred alias for `name`, used to define the name of the Kasm Zone to deploy management resources for. If both `name` and `zone_name` are set, `name` wins.
zone_name.title: zone_name

labels.description: Custom labels to apply to all deployed resources
labels.title: labels

nodeSelector.description: Configure node selector settings for your Kasm pods - [Kubernetes Node Selector](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#nodeselector).
nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector

proxyService.description: Configure the external-facing service type to use. Allowed service types: ClusterIP or LoadBalancer. The service.annotations defined here only apply to the `proxy` service (`proxy-service-external.yaml` file). If you wish to apply annotations to all services, use the annotations.service value at the bottom of this chart.  NOTE: If ingress.enabled or route.enabled set to `true` service.type MUST be set to `ClusterIP`. Also, if you wish to deploy a multi-zone Kasm (see [Deployment Zones](https://docs.kasm.com/docs/latest/guide/deployment_zones/index.html) documentation for reference), you MUST use either a Route or an Ingress and set the `proxyService.type` to `ClusterIP`.
proxyService.title: proxyService

publicAddr.description: Set the access URL to be used for the Kasm deployment. This is the URL you will use to access your Kasm deployment. This URL can be a private address, it just needs to be resolvable by systems you use to interface with Kasm.
publicAddr.title: publicAddr

restartPolicy.description: Configure global Pod restart policy for Kasm resources
restartPolicy.title: restartPolicy

route.description: Configure an OpenShift Route for your Kasm deployment.

enabled.description: Set the enabled value to `true` to use a pre-defined Route service to expose Kasm
enabled.title: enabled

backendProtocol.description: The backend protocol to for the OpenShift Route to communicate with the Kasm proxy service. Valid values: http or https
backendProtocol.title: backendProtocol

wildcardPolicy.description: Set the wildcard policy for the OpenShift Route. Valid values: None, Subdomain
wildcardPolicy.title: wildcardPolicy

tls.description: Object to define the TLS configuration for your OpenShift Route - [Configuring Secure Routes](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_dedicated/4/html/networking/configuring-routes#configuring-default-certificate).
tls.title: tls

route.title: route
